evals.name: full-migration-stateful-server
evals.prompt: unser acme-search-mcp läuft noch auf der alten MCP spec und ich hab gehört ab 2026-07-28 bricht das. kannst du den migrieren? liegt in acme-search-mcp/ — sag mir am ende bitte was du geändert hast
evals.expected_output: Diagnosis via the bundled checker, then an actual migration: session Map and Mcp-Session-Id routing removed, initialize/onsessioninitialized handling gone, logging + roots capabilities removed, per-session tenant resolution moved into the request path, and the SDK moved off @modelcontextprotocol/sdk onto the v2 packages (@modelcontextprotocol/server + /client). Plus a summary naming rule ids. Must NOT advise '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk@^2' — that version does not exist; v2 is a package rename.

evals.name: triage-false-positive-readiness
evals.prompt: kannst du mal prüfen ob mein notes-mcp server bereit ist für die 2026-07-28 spec? liegt im ordner notes-mcp/. bitte noch nichts umbauen, ich will erstmal wissen woran ich bin
evals.expected_output: Separates the two findings correctly. MCP002 is a FALSE POSITIVE — the sessionId at src/index.ts:24 is express-session for the admin UI, not MCP session state, and the MCP transport already uses sessionIdGenerator: undefined. MCP007 is REAL — the server is on the v1 @modelcontextprotocol/sdk line. Should not refactor anything (the user asked for diagnosis only), and should note MCP006 needs a live probe.

evals.name: triage-rust-false-positive-readiness
evals.prompt: kannst du mal prüfen ob mein rust-notes-mcp server bereit ist für die 2026-07-28 spec? liegt im ordner rust-notes-mcp/. bitte noch nichts umbauen, ich will erstmal wissen woran ich bin
evals.expected_output: MCP010 fires — Cargo.toml pins rmcp = "1.2.0", a pre-2026-07-28 line; rmcp 3.x is the current line. Should not refactor anything (the user asked for diagnosis only).

evals.name: triage-go-minor-version-break
evals.prompt: unser go-notes-mcp server soll auf die 2026-07-28 spec. kannst du schauen was da dran ist und es dann auch gleich machen? liegt in go-notes-mcp/
evals.expected_output: MCP011 fires: go.mod requires github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk v1.6.1, below v1.7.0 — the first release speaking 2026-07-28. Must upgrade to v1.7.0 on the SAME module path and must NOT advise a /v2 import path or a 2.x major: the Go SDK crossed the break inside its v1 line and no go-sdk/v2 module exists. Also fires MCP001, MCP002 (the per-session notes map is real state, unlike the go-tasks-mcp trap), MCP003 and MCP005 — the deprecated logging and roots calls. A correct migration upgrades the requirement, drops the GetSessionID option and the InitializedHandler, and moves the notes map behind an explicit handle passed as a tool argument.

evals.name: triage-go-false-positive-readiness
evals.prompt: kannst du mal prüfen ob mein go-tasks-mcp server bereit ist für die 2026-07-28 spec? liegt im ordner go-tasks-mcp/. bitte noch nichts umbauen, ich will erstmal wissen woran ich bin
evals.expected_output: Clean: no findings, grade A. The server is already on go-sdk v1.7.0 and its streamable HTTP transport sets Stateless: true, which is what serves 2026-07-28 at all. Both sessionId hits are FALSE POSITIVES — TaskArgs.SessionID is a caller-supplied handle passed as an ordinary tool argument (precisely what MCP002's own remediation recommends) and adminSession is a cookie for the operator UI on a separate surface. Must NOT refactor anything, must NOT remove Stateless: true (that would downgrade the server to 2025-11-25), and must not read the absence of modern protocol literals as evidence of anything: the Go SDK answers server/discover internally, so go.mod is the only place modernity is visible.
